title: Process cutaway
idea: Process cutaway: An original cutaway or flow reveals input, transformation and output in an ordered causal story.
audience: People who need to understand mechanism within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Understanding how something works reduces genuine uncertainty.
avoidWhen: A theatrical diagram would imply unbuilt functionality.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic process layout through its understand mechanism priority and explicit commitment contract: Separate implemented stages from conceptual or future steps.
navigation: Process cutaway keeps the current understand mechanism context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: An original cutaway or flow reveals input, transformation and output in an ordered causal story.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to understand mechanism; understanding how something works reduces genuine uncertainty.
composition.priority: Separate implemented stages from conceptual or future steps.

imagery.role: Support the actual understand mechanism context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Replace wide connecting arrows with a numbered semantic reading sequence if useful.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the process cutaway structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no understand mechanism content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; Separate implemented stages from conceptual or future steps.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized understand mechanism content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: Separate implemented stages from conceptual or future steps.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active understand mechanism context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate with browser study renders. Automated browser checks are recorded in evals/specimen-review.json. No independent visual comparison, task study or native runtime verification; remains draft. The illustration/task content demonstrates composition and does not prescribe every linked palette or font.
